output.arguments:
{"code":"def transform(g):
    # crop the band bounded by horizontal marker rows and the vertical 9, using left edge
    vs=[j for j in range(len(g[0])) if sum(r[j]==9 for r in g)>=len(g)-1]
    v=vs[0] if vs else 0
    hs=[i for i,r in enumerate(g) if sum(x==r[0] and x!=0 for x in r)>=len(r)-1]
    if len(hs)>=2: a,b=hs[0],hs[1]
    else: a,b=0,len(g)-1
    return [r[:v+1] for r in g[a:b+1]]"}
